title: Shop processing and delivery
help: Inspect this bot's work and replies, retry a failed operation or cancel pending work. Successful work and sent messages cannot be replayed here. Active leases must expire before recovery is offered.
conflict: This record changed. Your note is retained. Refresh the record and check its current state before choosing another action.
workHelp: Retry keeps the original incoming event and opens a fresh attempt budget. Current customer, invoice and purchase rules are checked again. Cancellation does not reverse a completed payment or purchase. Paused processing waits for its settings or schedule to be enabled.
messageHelp: Retry sends the stored reply and opens a fresh delivery budget. It can duplicate a message Telegram previously received. Cancel stops future delivery; it cannot retract a delivered message. Neither action posts a wallet credit or purchase. Delivery pauses are preserved.
unavailable: There is no recovery action for the current state. Refresh after active work finishes or its lease expires.
